Graduate Academics
Get advanced, real-world experience through hands-on learning, modern labs, and research
opportunities. Whether you want to move up in your current job or start a new career,
we’ll prepare you to succeed. With our 4+1 Accelerated Program, you can earn both
your bachelor’s and master’s degrees in just five years!
Built for Your Success
150+
Programs options from master to doctoral, designed to match your goals and interests.
Graduate Programs
60+
Years of offering graduate programs that prepare students for real-world success.
About A-State
7
Distinct colleges offering a wide range of graduate-level disciplines.
Apply Now
Driving Graduate Excellence at A-State
At the helm of Arkansas State University's Graduate School is Dr. Steven Beaupre,
a distinguished scientist and academic leader whose career spans elite research,
mentorship, and visionary program development.
Graduate School is a surefire way to improve your life, your career, and your impact
on the world around you!
Dr. Steven Beaupre
— Dean
As a nationally recognized leader in ecological and evolutionary biology, Dr. Beaupre
leads the A-State Graduate School with over three decades of groundbreaking research
and academic leadership. He has secured millions in competitive funding from the National
Science Foundation and other agencies, advancing conservation science and bioenergetics
and is celebrated for his mentorship, innovation, and commitment to student success.

Graduate Assistantships
How to Earn While You Learn
There are over 250 graduate assistantships filled each year. These roles provide valuable experience
and financial support while you complete your degree.
You can find 3 types of graduate assistantships:
Graduate Teaching Assistants (GTA)
Graduate Research Assistants (GRA)
Graduate Administrative Support Assistants (GSA).
Student Research
Promoting Student Research
Grad students at A-State turn their ideas into real research that impacts the Delta
region and beyond. From hands-on projects to faculty-guided studies, our students
tackle current challenges. Come explore their work and see how student research shapes
shapes our future.
Three Minute Thesis Competition
Graduate Student Council
The Graduate Student Council serves as the main support organization for graduate
students. Graduate Student Council is also an advocate for clarification of graduate
student employment and serves to protect the rights of graduate students. The council
works for the benefit of the University community and serves as an advocate and resource
for A-State students. The council works to recognize, foster, and promote outstanding
leadership and high academic achievement among graduate and doctoral students.
